$doc.summary: REST API surface required to drive the 4X wireframe frontend. All endpoints are relative to a base URL e.g. /api/v1. All responses are JSON. All mutation endpoints (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) accept and return JSON. The frontend fetches these on load and after each action; the server is the single source of truth.
$doc.auth: Bearer token in Authorization header. All endpoints require authentication.

conventions.turn_id: Integer turn number. All game-state endpoints are implicitly scoped to the active game session.
conventions.q_r: Axial hex coordinates. q = column, r = row.
conventions.yields: { f, p, g, sci, cul, faith } — all integers, per-turn deltas.

endpoints.comment: Top resource bar and global player variables.

routes.desc: Returns current player resources, turn, era, happiness, strategic resources.

endpoints.comment: Hex tile grid, camera state, edge overlays.

routes.desc: Sparse tile snapshot around the camera. Query params: q, r, radius (default 12). Returns world metadata + visible tiles.
Single tile detail including adjacency bonuses, worked-by city, improvement.

Toggle a named overlay on/off. Body: { active: bool }.

endpoints.comment: All player units and their action dispatch.

routes.desc: All player units with full stats, promotions, and action availability.
routes.poll: on turn-end, after any unit action

routes.desc: Single unit detail.
Dispatch a unit action. Body: { action_id, target_q?, target_r? }. Returns updated unit + affected tiles.

endpoints.comment: Army / corps formation and combat preview.

routes.desc: All armies and corps with unit membership and cohesion.

Combat odds preview. Query: attacker_id, defender_q, defender_r. Returns predicted damage and outcome.

endpoints.comment: Tech tree state and research queue.

Append tech to queue. Body: { tech_id }.

endpoints.comment: Civics tree, government, and active policies.

Remove civic from queue.
